offense.name: Low Pass
offense.effect: Ball to closest teammate forward/backward (max 2 dist.), or a teammate sharing space (player moves 1). Ball speed +1.

offense.name: Dribble Advance
offense.effect: Player and ball move forward 1 space. Manipulate ball speed (up to oSkill).

offense.name: High Pass
offense.effect: Ball moves forward 2-3 spaces. 2: may set up for scoring; 3+: must win a skill test to keep (with speed bonus).

defense.name: Block Deflect
defense.effect: Ball moves back 1 space. If overshoots the goal, may set up scoring. Ball speed -1.

defense.name: Steal Intercept
defense.effect: Turnover. Defender and ball move back 1 space. Manipulate ball speed after turnover (up to dSkill).

defense.name: Pressure
defense.effect: Player and ball go back 1 space. Defender moves 1 forward. If overshoots goal, own goal risk.
